source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

parts.target: An **EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE** unit of yours that has not yet been **selected to move** in this phase.
parts.effect:
Whenever a model in the unit moves, for the rest of the phase:

- it can pass through enemy models, except **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**
- while doing so, it can enter their [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) but cannot end the move there
- it passes any **[Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)** automatically

data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase).

**Target:** An **EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE** unit of yours that has not yet been **selected to move** in this phase.

**Effect:** Whenever a model in the unit moves, for the rest of the phase:

- it can pass through enemy models, except **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**
- while doing so, it can enter their [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) but cannot end the move there
- it passes any **[Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)** automatically
